title: Special Topics in Film Studies II; Film Noir and American Culture
department: School of Languages, Literatures and Cultures
description:
Prerequisite: ENGL245, FILM245, SLLC283, or FILM283; or permission of ARHU-College of Arts & Humanities. Cross-listed with FILM451. Credit only granted for FILM451 or SLLC468A.

Introduction to a variety of American movies made in the 1940s and 1950s whose dark themes and stark black-and-white lighting led to their identification as film noir.
